properties.title: Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): Land and Water Area
properties.description: The Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): Land and Water Area Grids measure surface areas in square kilometers. The land area grid provides estimates of the land area, excluding permanent ice and water, within each pixel. The water area grid provides estimates of the water area (permanent ice and water), within each pixel. The sum of land area and water area of a pixel equals the total surface area of that pixel.
properties.sci:citation: Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016-07-11. Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): Land and Water Area. Version 4.0. ESDIS. Palisades, NY. https://doi.org/10.7927/H45M63M9
ciesin:authors: Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University
ciesin:publishers: NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC)
properties.ciesin:purpose: To provide pixel-level land and water surface area estimates.
